name: Master Fire Breather
body:
You have mastered the ability to breathe fire through your torches, and can do so with great effect.

Prerequisite(s): Pyro fire breather special torch attack class feature, base attack bonus +5.

Benefit(s): Your fire breather special torch attack ability inflicts 1d8 points of damage per two levels, instead of 1d6, and has a 50% chance to ignite targets that fail their save, as if they had been ignited by your torch melee attack. You may also now imbibe the volatile alchemical liquid as a free action instead of a move action, though spitting the fire still requires a standard action.
